questions.q: I want every line coming out of this logger to carry a request_id - what's the call for that?
questions.why: Entry.WithField/WithFields/WithError build a duplicated entry carrying the fields; Logger.WithField etc. are the entry-point wrappers that pull an entry from the pool.

questions.q: where does the code actually decide whether to emit ANSI escapes or plain text?
questions.why: isColored() and isTerminal() decide it: DisableColors, ForceColors, the cached checkIfTerminal result, and CLICOLOR/CLICOLOR_FORCE, then Format branches to printColored vs printPlain.

questions.q: if two hooks are registered for the same level and the first returns an error, does the second still run?
questions.why: Entry.fireHooks prints 'Failed to fire hook' to stderr and returns immediately on the first error; LevelHooks.Fire has the same short-circuit.

questions.q: when file/line reporting is turned on, how does it skip past logrus's own stack frames to find my code?
questions.why: getCaller() caches the logrus package name via a sync.Once, then walks runtime.CallersFrames comparing getPackageName(f.Function) until it leaves the package.

questions.q: I passed a closure as a field value and it disappeared from the output - what happened to it?
questions.why: addField reflects on the value and drops func / *func kinds, recording 'skipping unsupported field' in entry.err (surfaced as the logrus_error field).

questions.q: I need to flush my metrics buffer before a Fatal call tears the process down - is there somewhere to register that?
questions.why: RegisterExitHandler/DeferExitHandler append/prepend to the handlers slice and runHandlers recovers per handler; Logger.Exit calls runHandlers before ExitFunc.

questions.q: what stops a field I happen to name msg from overwriting the real message in the output?
questions.why: prefixFieldClashes moves colliding time/msg/level/logrus_error keys to 'fields.<key>', resolving names through FieldMap first.

questions.q: in a unit test, how do I capture what got logged and assert on it without writing to stdout?
questions.why: test.Hook records every Entry; NewNullLogger returns a logger writing to io.Discard plus the hook, with LastEntry/AllEntries/Reset accessors.

questions.q: a library wants an io.Writer for its error output - can I hand it something backed by the logger?
questions.why: Logger.Writer/WriterLevel and Entry.WriterLevel return an *io.PipeWriter; a goroutine scans lines and calls the per-level print func, with a finalizer closing the writer.

questions.q: when bridging to log/slog, which slog level does a logrus Warn become, and what comes back the other way?
questions.why: toSlogLevel/toLogrusLevel plus the slogLevelTrace..slogLevelPanic constants define both directions, including the Fatal=Error+2, Panic=Error+4 offsets.

questions.q: if I wire slog into logrus and also logrus back into slog, what keeps a record from bouncing between them forever?
questions.why: Hook.Fire stamps the logger into the context via withLogrusLogger, and Handler.Handle bails out early when hasLogrusLogger reports it already passed through.

questions.q: if slog code calls WithGroup before logging, what do the resulting field keys look like on the logrus side?
questions.why: appendAttr flattens group attrs and joins the group stack with '.' as a key prefix; WithGroup/WithAttrs maintain the groups slice and fields map.

questions.q: colours work on Linux but not in a Windows console - where's the Windows-specific terminal detection?
questions.why: checkIfTerminal calls windows.GetConsoleMode on the *os.File handle and sets ENABLE_VIRTUAL_TERMINAL_PROCESSING, returning false if either call fails.

questions.q: coloured output prints WARN instead of WARNING and the columns don't line up - which settings control that and where does the shortening happen?
questions.why: formatLevel/levelPrefix do the uppercase, 4-char truncation, padding and colouring behind a sync.OnceValues cache; TextFormatter's DisableLevelTruncation/PadLevelText are passed into levelPrefix from printColored.

questions.q: why does an error value come out as its message text in JSON rather than an empty object?
questions.why: Format's copy loop type-switches on error and stores v.Error(), because encoding/json would otherwise emit {}.

questions.q: can I get my custom fields grouped under a sub-object in the JSON instead of mixed in with time/level/msg?
questions.why: The DataKey option re-wraps the collected data map under that single key before the standard fields are added.

questions.q: is it safe to change the log level from another goroutine while requests are being logged?
questions.why: SetLevel/level() use atomic.StoreUint32/LoadUint32 over Logger.Level, and IsLevelEnabled reads through level().

questions.q: where do the byte buffers that formatters write into come from, and can I supply my own?
questions.why: buffer_pool.go defines the BufferPool interface, the sync.Pool default and the global SetBufferPool; Entry.log gets/puts a buffer via getBufferPool, and Logger has a BufferPool field with SetBufferPool.

questions.q: I read a level like "WARNING" out of a YAML config - how do I turn that string into the level type?
questions.why: ParseLevel/parseLevel do a case-insensitive match (accepting both warn and warning), and Level implements UnmarshalText/MarshalText for config decoding.

questions.q: how do I route error-and-above to a second destination while normal output keeps going where it already goes?
questions.why: writer.Hook holds a Writer plus LogLevels; Levels() returns those levels and Fire formats the entry with entry.Bytes() and writes it.
